newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil car output up 12.53 pct in Oct vs yr-ago.
newsitem.headline: Brazil car output up 12.53 pct in Oct vs yr-ago.

text.p: Brazilian car output reached 169,916 vehicles in October, up 12.53 percent from the same month last year, Brazil's Motor Manufacturers Association (Anfavea) said it a report.
October output also rose 2.28 percent from the 166,135 vehicles assembled in September, it said.
Car output in the first ten months of the year reached 1.384 million vehicles, it added.
Brazil domestic car sales rose 15.94 percent from a year earlier to 141,764 from 122,271 vehicles sold, it said. Sales also rose 3.20 percent compared with September sales of 137,371 cars.
Brazilian car manufacturers exported 29,421 units last month, against 22,608 in October 1995, up 30.14 percent, it said.
However, exports fell when compared with the 30,549 cars exported in September, it added.
